summary: Provision an ephemeral sandbox + a loopback OAuth client + a user, enrol a TOTP authenticator, and prove the second-factor challenge on sign-in; then hard-delete the sandbox.

params.name: workspaceSlug
params.prompt: Standing workspace slug (the workspace your API key is scoped to; NOT created)

params.name: envSlug
params.prompt: Slug for the fresh ephemeral sandbox environment (a new one is created per run)

params.name: envName
params.prompt: Display name for the ephemeral sandbox environment

params.name: appName
params.prompt: Display name for the ephemeral OAuth client

steps.description: Create a fresh, throwaway SANDBOX environment in the standing workspace; later steps provision into it.
Register a public loopback authorization-code client INSIDE the fresh sandbox environment.
Register a verified, sign-in-able user IN the sandbox; the journey enrols TOTP for this user.
